items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Russell, another friend of ours, he's got the drum.

ctx.x: Joe comes with the kazoo. Russell, another friend of ours, he's got the drum. He gets the top of a cheese-box and had a little drum. And we're sitting on my steps.
Now, every evening there's a concert. And the people would stop, because we were beginning to sound good. "Little Liza Jane"...
